entries.source: Connect to Globulation 2 games on your local network.
entries.target: तुमच्या स्थानिक नेटवर्कवरील Globulation 2 खेळांशी जोडणी करण्यासाठी.
entries.rationale: Purpose fragment जोडणी करण्यासाठी correctly explains why access is requested; खेळांशी faithfully preserves generic games and avoids an imperative. Exact product name and your local network retained.

entries.source: Globulation 2 discovers and joins multiplayer games hosted on your local network.
entries.target: Globulation 2 तुमच्या स्थानिक नेटवर्कवर होस्ट केलेले अनेक खेळाडूंचे सामने शोधते आणि त्यांत सामील होते.
entries.rationale: Consistent neuter application agreement and plural त्यांत. Both discovery and joining of locally hosted multiplayer matches are explicit. Exact product name and local network retained.

method: Actual final InfoPlist.strings values reread against both English plist sources; purpose wording and local-network discovery/joining inspected.
limits: Source and resource linguistic recheck; no Apple runtime dialog screenshot claim.
